name: -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Female to Male Union
title: -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Female to Male Union
description:
The -10 AN Fitting 90 Degree Female to Male Union is engineered for high-demand automotive fluid systems. ColorFittings 90 Degree Female to Male Union Adapters are precision CNC-machined to provide a compact 90-degree connection between AN fittings, improving hose routing and clearance in tight engine bays. Designed with a true 37-degree AN flare on both ends, these adapters deliver a secure, leak-free seal for fuel, oil, coolant, transmission, brake, and power steering systems.

Manufactured from aerospace-grade 6061-T6 billet aluminum and finished with ColorFittings' proprietary polishing and anodizing process, these adapters offer exceptional strength, corrosion resistance, and long-term durability. Built for high-pressure and high-temperature environments, they are compatible with E85, ethanol-based fuels, race fuel, pump gas, diesel, oil, coolant, transmission fluid, hydraulic fluid, and air systems.

Perfect for street performance, racing, off-road, marine, and custom fabrication projects, these 90-degree AN unions provide clean hose routing without sacrificing flow or reliability.

Technical Specifications:
• Origin: Precision CNC-machined in the USA.
• Material & Finish: 6061-T6 Billet Aluminum with hard anodized protective finish.
• Flow Configuration: 90° mandrel-bent profile for maximum fluid velocity in tight engine bays.
